targets.query:
from(bucket: "network_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "interface_monitoring")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device_name == "${device_name}" and r.interface_name == "${interface_name}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "in_bps" or r._field == "out_bps")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with direction: if r._field == "in_bps" then "入方向" else "出方向" }))
  |> group(columns: ["device_name", "interface_name", "direction"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "direction"])
  |> yield(name: "traffic")

import "strings"

statusFilter = ${port_status:doublequote}
searchFilter = ${port_search:doublequote}

from(bucket: "network_metrics")
  |> range(start: -10m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "interface_monitoring")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device_name == "${device_name}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "oper_status" or r._field == "speed_bps" or r._field == "admin_up_oper_down")
  |> group(columns: ["interface_name", "_field"])
  |> last()
  |> group(columns: ["interface_name"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["interface_name"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => statusFilter == "all" or (statusFilter == "up" and exists r.oper_status and r.oper_status == 1.0) or (statusFilter == "down" and exists r.oper_status and r.oper_status == 0.0) or (statusFilter == "mismatch" and exists r.admin_up_oper_down and r.admin_up_oper_down == 1.0))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => searchFilter == "" or strings.containsStr(v: strings.toLower(v: r.interface_name), substr: strings.toLower(v: searchFilter)))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: now(), _value: if exists r.oper_status then r.oper_status else -1.0, interface_name: r.interface_name, port_label: r.interface_name + " / " + (if exists r.speed_bps and r.speed_bps >= 1000000000.0 then string(v: int(v: r.speed_bps / 1000000000.0)) + "G" else if exists r.speed_bps and r.speed_bps >= 1000000.0 then string(v: int(v: r.speed_bps / 1000000.0)) + "M" else "-") }))
  |> group(columns: ["port_label"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "port_label"])
  |> yield(name: "port_status")
